description: Per pending cohort in a segment (answers pending since the same entry epoch in the latest close record, plus the open epoch's answers): pending, no_seal (rows the record lists with no grade), expires_close (entry epoch + pending TTL), closes_left (minus the open epoch), expires_est_ts and watched (the E18 to E20 cohorts LabLeak post 1582, comment 6150 tracks). The TTL comes from minepoa's /api/params pending_ttl_epochs (ttl_source; segments.json for an archived segment); 16 is only a fallback, flagged in ttl_flags (Stale, Unconfirmed), and ttl_observed cross checks it against the grading list's expires minus since. estab_ttl carries the establishment TTL the same way. Counts only, never a pending score or seal. Use it to see when each pending cohort expires and which TTL value that rests on. CSV at /api/v1/governance/pending-horizon.csv.

dir.description: desc (default: the column's natural order) or asc (reversed); blanks last

segment.description: chain segment: omit for the current one; 1 reads segment 1 (archived at the 2026-10-24 genesis cut), whose epoch numbers repeat in the current segment

sort.description: row order: cohort (default, oldest entry epoch first) or a column

name: get_pending_horizon
title: Pending expiry horizon
